Maya Tran: ok putting the handoff here for the evening -> night shift. quick TL;DR: we had two customer-facing blips in the last 6h (embed-serving 503s for a subset of customers, and a separate KV eviction-induced latency bump). both pages are silenced now but followups remain. primary/secondary for next 12h: Samir primary, Natalie secondary. please ping Liam for infra escalations. :wave:

eng-oncall-bot: PAGER #4532 | SEV-2 | 2026-02-12T18:14:03Z | embed-service 503 spike -> routed. page routed to: oncall-eng, oncall-core.

Samir Patel: saw the pager earlier. I left the temporary firewall tweak in place to cut off a noisy client that was hitting a bad path, verified ingress is steady now. confirmed 503s dropped from ~12% -> ~0.6% across region. :white_check_mark:

Natalie Chen: re: KV eviction -- autoscaler kicked and we saw eviction churn when the embed batcher spiked memory. I bumped the autoscaler buffer to +15% and scheduled a rollout of a minor batcher memory cap change (small jar) that should land in 30m. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction#mitigation (see "quick containment").

Maya Tran: customer impact summary: 8 customers experienced degraded embeddings (timeouts/503s) intermittently for ~25-40m. downstream clients did automatic retries so few escalations; we logged elevated error-rates in billing and realtime alerts. CS already opened cases for two enterprise customers; case IDs: CS-3198, CS-3201.

Liam O'Connor: quick note on observability gaps — the prefix-cache hit metric wasn't being emitted for a small fleet behind the new envoy config. I reverted the envoy flag on that pool (flag: enable_prefix_cache_metrics=false -> true) and metrics resumed. would recommend adding a small alert to catch missing metric ingestion per-pool.

Samir Patel: current status checklist:
- embed 503s: contained, firewall rule still applied (manual)
- kv evictions: reduced, autoscaler buffer increased, rollout queued
- primary/secondary assigned: Samir/Natalie
- customer cases: created, notifying CSMs
- runbook references: KV eviction runbook + embed-service troubleshooting doc

Maya Tran: immediate next steps before handoff:
1) Samir: leave the manual firewall rule in place until 02:00 UTC or until you confirm no recurrence for 2h. add a note in the ticket when you remove it.
2) Natalie: monitor the batcher rollout and if memory doesn't stabilize after 2 full cycles, rollback and open a P0 to infra.
3) Liam: add metric ingestion alert and post the snippet here (i'll file a follow-up to product infra).
4) Everyone: if any enterprise customer hits >5% error for >10m, escalate to me + oncall-eng-sre.

eng-oncall-bot: NOTE: scheduled rollout windows -> embed-batcher v1.3.7 (canary in 12m, full in 32m).

Natalie Chen: posting the quick rollout CLI I used so handover has the exact steps:
```bash
# canary rollout to 5% of batchers
redwoodctl rollout start --service embed-batcher --version v1.3.7 --canary 5 --watch
# observe memory p95 and eviction-rate for 20m
```

Samir Patel: small gotcha: when the firewall rule was applied I saw a transient backlog in one queue; I drained it with `redwoodctl queue drain --queue embed-ingest-az-west-2`. left a note in the ticket.

Maya Tran: coverage gap to call out: EU-west-2 pool has reduced secondary coverage this weekend due to vacations (we have only 1 oncall rostered). if anything spikes there, escalate immediately to Liam who has cross-region access. I'm adding a calendar note for backup coverage.

Liam O'Connor: i'll take the escallation if EU goes sideways. also filing a follow-up to add a canary check to the autoscaler (small probe to validate eviction-rate under ramp).

Samir Patel: I'll post back in ~45m with a stability check. leaving my mobile on for pages. :telephone_receiver:

Maya Tran: thanks team — handoff complete. I'll be reachable for 2h if anyone needs context. leaving the final checklist below for the night team:
- verify embed 503 rate <= 1% for 2h after firewall removal
- confirm KV eviction p95 < 200ms across batchers after rollout
- close short-term CS cases or escalate to CS manager if customers request immediate credits
- create a short postmortem note in the incident board if either issue recurs

eng-oncall-bot: THREAD CLOSED (auto) — no active pages for 15m.

Natalie Chen: ack, noted. adding monitoring dashboard widgets to the night-handbook.

Samir Patel: stability check (45m): embed 503s at 0.4% across regions, no new errors in logs. will remove firewall at 01:45 UTC if stable.

Liam O'Connor: filed metric alert: `MissingMetricIngestionPerPool` -> threshold = 2 mins missing. PR: https://phabricator.redwood/12345

Maya Tran: last note — runbook pointers: embed-service troubleshooting (section: transient-503s), KV eviction mitigation (section: "quick containment"). both links in the ticket. good handoff, team. :rocket:
